parsed.note_claim: OpenAI claims its AI solved the Navier-Stokes problem; Buckmaster alleges OpenAI's proof builds on his and Alpöge's work after learning of it, and OpenAI denies this.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Buckmaster also posted a statement claiming that, last week, he learned that OpenAI had become aware of his and Alpöge's work and had started putting significant resources toward the problem.
parsed.reason: The Wired article reports OpenAI's solution claim, Buckmaster's allegation about OpenAI learning of and building on their work, and OpenAI's denial ("we did not use their prompt or proof to prompt our models or direct our agents").
